pins.definition: A pair of thin sticks used as eating utensils, especially in East Asian cuisine.
A pair of thin sticks held in one hand and used as utensils for eating, especially in East Asian cuisine.
A pair of slender sticks held in one hand and used for eating Asian food.

situation: A person at a low wooden table lifts a single morsel with two slender carved wooden rods.
subject: two slender sticks held in one hand as eating utensils
brief: A hand holds a pair of slender lacquered wooden sticks lifted mid-air above a ceramic bowl, holding a single dumpling between their converging tips. The two parallel rods are the central focus of the frame, cleanly silhouetted against a muted paper screen background.
